name: Our Shopping List
description_en: Simple shared list application including shopping lists and any other small todo-list that needs to be used collaboratively. ([Demo](https://osl.lanterne-rouge.info/)) `AGPL-3.0` `Docker`
description: OSL is a simple shared list web-application based on Node and VueJS. Typical uses include shopping lists of course, and any other small todo-list that needs to be used collaboratively.
readme_preview: OSL is a simple **shared list** application. Typical uses include **shopping lists** of course, and any other small todo-list that needs to be used **collaboratively**.
